name: landflow-brain
description: Your own Claude Code work in the Landflow company brain: a local journal, a summary held for your review, and your yesterday back at the next session

url.title: Landflow URL
url.description: Where your Landflow runs: https://, or http://localhost. Empty: nothing is recorded or sent.

key.title: API key
key.description: A Landflow API key with the brain:write scope (Settings, API keys). Empty: nothing is recorded or sent.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: The repositories whose sessions are recorded, owner/name, separated by commas or spaces. Empty: none.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: review: hold each session until you send it; auto: send it at the end (unless your admin forbids it); off: record nothing.

sync.title: Load yesterday
sync.description: At the start of a session, bring in your own work from yesterday.
